confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the supplied comparables; no live listings, booking pages, or menus were checked. Restaurant and hostel anchors are the firmer estimates, while hotel rates vary widely by area and season. Cocktail (about 1.9 times beer) and wine glass (about 1.2 times beer) are derived from the local beer relationship because direct bar-price knowledge is weak, and alcohol prices carry extra uncertainty from taxation. The FX figure comes from search-result snippets of the RBA page, not a directly opened page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Middle East mid-cost capital, calibrated between the supplied Colombo and Phnom Penh references (food and hostel levels set above both) and the Tel Aviv reference (hotel and mid-range dining set well below it).
